row:
Providing exotic pet owners with critical supplies and knowledge they need when immediate vet care isn't possible. This channel focuses on common accidents or injuries that can occur with sugar gliders and other exotic pets that require intervention from owners while they seek out veterinary care. 

DISCLAIMER: I am not a veterinarian or licensed veterinary technician. I have owned sugar gliders since 2019 and run into a variety of medical problems that have allowed me to learn how to temporarily treat acute situations until I can get my pet to a veterinarian. These videos are not a replacement for veterinary diagnostics and care. 

For questions about sugar glider husbandry and care, please refer to Sugar Glider Diaries here on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@sugargliderdiaries
